review_mode: Codex author self-review; candidate task acceptance only

criteria.criterion: A changed baseline between review and simulated application forces fresh checking.
criteria.finding: Fourteen real boundary cases capture current source/state/epoch identities, refuse stale or substituted reviews and run all nine hard checks again at application. Review and application evidence directories are distinct; the shadow snapshot contains the actually checked added assertion.

criteria.criterion: Keep the candidate recommendation distinct from human authority and actual admission.
criteria.finding: Shadow application changes only the explicit candidate snapshot. All outputs retain authority_effect none, human_authority_granted false and no reused review evidence; human assessment and admission remain separate.

failure_controls.control: Exercise review-to-application source drift and replay substitution.
failure_controls.finding: Actual simulation-source byte drift, epoch and semantic-baseline changes, proposal/bundle substitution and altered review bytes reject with a fresh-check requirement. Historical mutable-input bindings are observations; immutable before/after snapshots document what was tested.

failure_controls.control: No writes to live governance stores, runtime state, keys or immutable source records.
failure_controls.finding: State paths are restricted to the candidate shadow directory, initialization refuses replacement, and a supplied authority path cannot become state. All captured authority source bytes remain identical. The cooperative lock and local-filesystem claim ceiling are explicit.
